statement: Let a byte string w be a proper suffix of a byte string v when len(w) < len(v) and for every k with 0 <= k < len(w), w[k] = v[len(v)-len(w)+k]. Let U be the set of byte strings w such that (a) words[i] = w for some i with 0 <= i < n, and (b) w is not a proper suffix of words[j] for any j with 0 <= j < n. Then the function returns a result r and r = sum_{w in U} (len(w) + 1).
preconditions: Let n = len(words). Preconditions: 1 <= n <= 2000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= len(words[i]) <= 7 and every byte of words[i] is an ASCII lowercase letter (byte value between 97 and 122).
